description: This file defines an interface IController in the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, which is deprecated. The interface declares several pure virtual methods related to device or system control such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface representing a deprecated external controller with methods for persisting state, deleting resources, rebooting, managing environment variables, configuration, and cloning devices or systems.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource at the specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment information associated with the given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specified callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a device or system from a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
